exposure: prepregnancy BMI category: normal weight, overweight, obese class I, obese class II, and obese class III
pregnancy changes in body mass index (BMI)
finding: Excessive BMI change during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery across all prepregnancy BMI categories.
mod_finding: The study found that excessive weight gain during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of Cesarean delivery, regardless of pre-pregnancy BMI.
